name: torah-skills
description: Reusable Torah study skills for source-first parashah analysis and curated Jewish learning artifacts.

interface.longDescription: Torah Skills packages a reusable methodology for producing curated Torah study outputs from primary and classical sources. The website is one consumer of the skill; the methodology can also guide essays, lessons, scripts, image briefs, and reflective study artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use Torah Skills to draft this week's parashah study.
Use Torah Skills to adapt a parashah into a lesson.
Use Torah Skills to review a chapter for source quality.
